pricing.title: Know what you'll pay. Know what you'll earn.
pricing.description: Agree on the task price before booking. See each service fee and any expense allowance before you confirm.
pricing.paymentTiming: You pay when you book. Your helper is paid after the task is done.
pricing.posterFeeDescription: Added to the task price, with a minimum of {minimum} per booking.
pricing.helperFeeDescription: Deducted from the task price. You'll see your earnings before you agree.
pricing.fixedIntro: For a fixed-price task, you and your helper agree on the price for the whole task. Here is a {price} example.
pricing.fixedHelperTitle: Fixed price: what your helper earns
pricing.minimumDescription: On this {price} task, the {minimum} minimum service fee applies. The total is shown below.
pricing.hourlyTitle: Hourly help, with an agreed cap
pricing.hourlyDescription: You pay for the agreed hours cap and service fee when you book. After the task, you approve the hours worked. Unused hours and their fee share are refunded. Extra hours need your agreement and payment first.
pricing.expensesDescription: Agree on an expense allowance before your helper buys supplies. You approve receipts after the task. Unused allowance is refunded, and neither person pays a service fee on reimbursed expenses.
pricing.cancellationDescription: Cancel free at least {hours} hours before the task starts. Later cancellations cost {percent}% of the task price or {minimum}, whichever is greater, up to the task price. Your helper receives all of that fee.
pricing.cancellationEarly: You cancel at least {hours} hours before the start
pricing.cancellationLate: You cancel less than {hours} hours before the start
pricing.lateFeeExample: In this example, the late cancellation fee is {fee}. Your helper receives {received}, and you get {refund} back.
pricing.approvalTitle: Time to check the finished task
pricing.approvalDescription: After your helper submits completion, you have {hours} hours to approve it or report a problem. After that, the task is approved automatically. Reporting a problem pauses payment while it is reviewed.
pricing.inviteDescription: An invite places a hold on your card for up to {hours} hours. You're charged only if the helper accepts. The hold is released if they decline or don't answer in time.

becomeHelper.title: Put your everyday skills to work nearby

becomeHelper.requirementsTitle: A few checks before your first booking
becomeHelper.identityDescription: Complete an ID and selfie check so clients can see your ID-verified badge.
becomeHelper.payoutDescription: Add your payout details so payments can reach your bank after completed tasks.
becomeHelper.backgroundTitle: Complete a background check for in-home help
becomeHelper.backgroundDescription: In-home categories require a background check before you can accept bookings in those categories.
becomeHelper.earningsTitle: An example of what you'll earn
becomeHelper.earningsDescription: Your task price and service fee are shown separately. Approved expenses are reimbursed separately from earnings.
becomeHelper.timingDescription: Your payment is sent after the task is completed and approved, or approved automatically. It usually reaches your bank in about 2 business days.
becomeHelper.firstPayout: Your first payout can take about {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
becomeHelper.rewardsTitle: Gift card rewards for helping locally
becomeHelper.rewardsDescription: Gift cards are separate from your task earnings. Available programs and their terms are shown here.
becomeHelper.welcomeOffer: Get verified, get a {amount} gift card
becomeHelper.welcomeTerms: Every helper who passes our checks gets one. No spots to race for, and no first task needed.
becomeHelper.welcomeUnlock: Our team gives it a quick check, then you pick your card. Redeem within {redeemDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. One welcome gift card per person.
becomeHelper.repeatOffer: A {amount} gift card for helping the same client again
becomeHelper.repeatTerms: Earn your reward after your {bookings, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} paid booking of {minimum} or more with the same client within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Each booking must meet this minimum. Available once per helper and client pair.
becomeHelper.repeatUnlock: The reward unlocks {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the qualifying task is paid. Redeem within {redeemDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of unlocking.
becomeHelper.rewardConditions: Refunds, disputes, or safety reviews can delay or change eligibility. Gift cards may be taxable income. Programs can change or end at any time.
becomeHelper.rewardPolicy: Rewards never depend on reviews or ratings.
becomeHelper.closingDescription: Start with your profile, services, and the areas you cover.

payment.question: When do I pay?
payment.answer: You pay when you book. Your helper is paid after the task is done.

address.question: Who can see my address?
address.answer: Helpers see only the general area. Your exact address is shared with your helper after you book.

account.question: Can I post tasks and help others?
account.answer: Yes. One account has two modes: “I need help” and “I can help.” Complete your helper setup before sending offers.

rebook.question: Can I book the same helper again?
rebook.answer: Yes. Save your helper or choose Book again from a completed booking. Check the task details, time, and price before sending an invite.

costGuide.stepsTitle: How to get an exact price

steps.post: Post your task with these details. Posting is free.
steps.offers: Helpers near you send offers with their price, and you can ask them questions first.
steps.book: You see the service fee and your total before you book, and you pay when you book.

furniture-assembly.intro: Turn a flat-pack box into furniture you can use. Share the item details so your helper can plan the work.
furniture-assembly.pricing: Agree on a fixed price per item before booking. Include the item count, model, access details, and any anti-tip anchoring in the scope.

included.one: Flat-pack furniture, including beds, desks, and shelves
included.two: Anti-tip anchoring agreed as part of the task

moving-help.intro: A hand with the lifting, loading, and packing. Moving help covers the physical work; arrange your own transport.
moving-help.pricing: Agree on an hourly rate and a maximum number of hours. You pay for the cap when you book. Unused time is refunded after the final hours are approved.

included.two: Moving furniture within or between rooms

yard-cleanup.intro: Tidy the outdoor spaces you use every day, with work that stays safely at ground level.
yard-cleanup.pricing: Agree on a fixed price for the cleanup, or an hourly rate with a cap. For hourly tasks, unused time is refunded after the final hours are approved.

light-cleaning.intro: Help with the usual cleaning and a light tidy. Describe the rooms, supplies, and any pets before booking.
light-cleaning.pricing: Agree on a fixed price based on home size and scope, or an hourly rate with a cap. Any extra work needs an agreed change before it starts.

excluded.three: Exterior windows above the ground floor

computer-help.intro: Get comfortable with your computer or phone, at home or through a guided screen-sharing session.
computer-help.pricing: Choose a fixed package, including a 30- or 60-minute remote session, or agree on an hourly rate with a cap. Review the full price before booking.

excluded.one: Unattended remote access or remote-control tools
excluded.two: A helper handling passwords or financial accounts

howItWorks.title: A clear plan, from start to finish
howItWorks.description: One account, two ways to take part. Choose the side that fits what you need today.

one.title: Describe your task
one.body: Choose a category, add the details, and set a date, time window, and budget. You can post without adding a payment method.

two.title: Compare offers or invite a helper
two.body: Check profiles, verification badges, and reviews. Ask questions in the app, or request a time from a helper’s availability.

three.title: Confirm the details and book
three.body: Review the scope, schedule, total, and cancellation terms. Pay to confirm an offer. Direct invites place a hold on your card; you’re charged when the helper accepts.

four.title: Keep the work on track
four.body: Use booking messages to coordinate. Agree to changes in scope, price, time, or hours before the extra work starts.

five.title: Approve, review, and book again
five.body: Check the completion details and approve or report a problem by the deadline shown. Save your helper and use Book again next time.

one.title: Complete your setup
one.body: Add your services and area, complete an ID check, and set up payouts. In-home tasks also require a background check.

two.title: Find tasks and send offers
two.body: Choose tasks that fit your skills and schedule. Include your price, proposed time, and what you’ll bring. You can also respond to direct invites.

three.title: Confirm the booking
three.body: Check the agreed scope and your earnings. You’ll see the exact address after the booking is confirmed. Begin once payment is confirmed in the app.

four.title: Do the task and share the result
four.body: Check in and keep the client updated. Submit completion details, photos when needed, hours for hourly tasks, and receipts for approved expenses.

five.title: Get paid and build repeat clients
five.body: After approval, earnings go to your payout account. Reimbursed expenses are shown separately. Leave an honest review and arrange the next booking through the app.

trustSafety.title: Trust starts with clear information
trustSafety.description: Know what was checked, what stays private, and where to turn if something goes wrong.

identity.title: ID verified
identity.body: A government ID and a selfie matched on the date shown. This checks identity, not skills or work quality.

background.title: Background checked
background.body: The background check returned clear on the date shown. In-home categories require a current check. Yard cleanup and remote computer help do not.

phone.title: Phone verified
phone.body: The person confirmed access to their phone number. This is separate from an ID check or a background check.

trustSafety.badgesLimit: Checks describe information at a point in time. They do not promise safety or work quality. Read the profile and discuss your task before booking.
trustSafety.privacyBody: Only your confirmed helper gets your exact address for the booking. Their access ends 48 hours after the task is completed.
trustSafety.contactMasking: Phone numbers and emails are hidden until the booking is confirmed.
trustSafety.paymentBody: See the full total before confirming. Keep messages, changes, and payments in the app so support can review the booking if there is a problem. Platform support and payment protection apply only to bookings made and paid here.
trustSafety.reviewsBody: After a completed booking, you and your helper can review each other. Reviews appear when both are submitted or after 14 days. Reviews can be reported, and low ratings are not hidden just because they are low.
trustSafety.reviewRewards: Reviews are optional and are not rewarded. Rewards never depend on reviews or ratings.
trustSafety.emergency: If you are in immediate danger, call 911 first.
trustSafety.reporting: Use the safety option in your booking to contact support about an urgent concern. You can also report a task, profile, message, or review. For a problem with completed work, report it from the booking before the approval deadline.
trustSafety.prohibitedBody: TasksNearMe covers everyday help. Licensed trades, childcare, personal care, and driving people are outside the service. Check the full list before you post.

about.title: About TasksNearMe
about.description: TasksNearMe (tasksnearme.com) is where you book a verified local helper for an everyday task, with the price agreed before anyone commits. We're opening city by city across the US, starting with Gainesville, Florida.
about.whatBody1: TasksNearMe connects people who need a hand with neighbors who can help: furniture assembly, moving help, yard cleanup, light cleaning, and computer and phone help.
about.whatBody2: You post a task or book a helper's open time, agree on a price up front, and pay through TasksNearMe. Your helper is paid after the task is done.
about.whatBody3: Helpers are independent: they choose their tasks, set their own prices and hours, and do the work themselves. TasksNearMe arranges the booking and the payment, and our support team helps when something goes wrong.

task.title: Clear before anyone commits
task.body: Every booking has a scope, a time window and a price before anyone commits.

money.title: No surprises on money
money.body: Before confirming, the person posting sees the total and the helper sees what they'll earn, fees included.

funded.title: Paid for before work starts
funded.body: A helper is never asked to start a task that isn't paid for yet.

privacy.title: Private by default
privacy.body: Public pages show only the general area. The exact address goes only to the booked helper, and only for as long as they need it.

platform.title: Everything in one place
platform.body: Messages, changes and payments stay in the app, so support can see what happened and resolve a problem fairly.

reviews.title: Rewards never buy reviews
reviews.body: Reviews are optional, and no reward depends on leaving one or on a rating.

account.title: One account, both sides
account.body: Anyone can post a task and help others with the same account.

about.whereBody: Gainesville, Florida is our first city. We open cities one at a time, in the order people ask for us, so wherever you are, you can join the waitlist and we'll tell you when we open near you.
about.trustBody: Every helper's profile shows what was checked and when: their phone, their ID and, for tasks inside your home, a current background check. Phone numbers and email addresses stay hidden until a booking is confirmed.
about.helpersBody: Helpers choose the tasks they want and set their own prices and hours. Sending offers is free, and every booked task is paid for before the work starts.
about.languagesBody: TasksNearMe works in English and Spanish, from the site to the emails and texts we send.
about.contactBody: Questions about TasksNearMe, a booking or your account? Write to our support team and we'll answer by email, usually within 24 hours.
